flaws.note: The service role key is read from a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable, so Next.js inlines it into the browser bundle; the admin client is importable from client components. May be reported on the env file that carries the NEXT_PUBLIC_ name.
notes has no row-level security and is granted to anon and authenticated; any user with the anon key can read every note through PostgREST.
GET and DELETE look the note up with the admin client by id only, never checking owner_id against the signed-in user.
Real-looking project keys committed; .gitignore does not exclude .env.local.
